items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I'm playing over there in Chick Webb's band.

ctx.x: Yeah, and when we got to the Lafayette Theatre he walked up and said, "Aren't you Margaret Bryant?" I said, "No, I'm Margaret Stratton," because I'd married. But he knew me as Margaret Bryant. He said, "When you come out of the theatre, come over to the Savoy Ballroom. I'm playing over there in Chick Webb's band." So we did. So that was our Sunday routine; we'd go to the Lafayette Theatre and look at the show and then we'd go over to the Savoy Ballroom. Everybody did.
